verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-user isolated storage, separate data per household member, and 'ZDR model routing'. ZDR model routing concerns retention by upstream model providers, not a user-facing control. Nothing documents user controls for setting retention periods or deleting stored data, memory, or accounts, so these related privacy features earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Every user gets their own isolated cloud machine with its own storage.
